text: Discipline positioning：Environmental engineering belongs to the field of engineering and is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates chemistry, biology, engineering and management. It focuses on pollution control, ecological protection and resource recycling, and studies the control technologies and management strategies for water, air, soil and solid waste pollution, aiming to solve environmental problems such as industrial wastewater, smog and excessive heavy metals in soil.Development background：With the acceleration of global industrialization, environmental pollution (such as PM2.5 and black and odorous water bodies) and ecological damage problems have become prominent. China's "14th Five-Year Plan" for ecological and environmental protection and the "Environmental Protection Law" and other policies have promoted the rapid development of environmental engineering technology. Carbon reduction and circular economy have become new research hotspots.
